queries.query: Iwo Nigeria official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Osun State survey mapping
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Osun State Office of the Surveyor General as the state cadastral, surveying, mapping and geospatial-data custodian. The official Osun directory also links an Osun Land Parcel Information System at ocofofasttrack.osun.gov.ng. No public Iwo parcel layer or anonymous geometry API was verified.

registryCustodian: Osun State Government Office of the Surveyor General, with the Ministry of Lands and Physical Planning as a collaborating land-administration ministry; the official state directory links an Osun Land Parcel Information System.

registryEvidence.custodianText: The Office of the Surveyor General states that it meets land-surveying needs of the State, Local Government and public, prepares maps, conducts survey investigations for land transactions, provides geospatial information products, and includes directors for cadastral/legal service and mapping/GIS/boundaries.
registryEvidence.directoryText: The Osun State official Helpful Links page lists Osun Land Parcel Information System and links to ocofofasttrack.osun.gov.ng.
registryEvidence.localityText: The official Osun Iwo page identifies Iwo as a major Osun town and local-government area; it does not expose a parcel layer or Iwo-specific registry endpoint.
registryEvidence.procedureOutcome: The state custodian page documents surveying, mapping and land-related services, but no anonymous parcel download, map-layer endpoint, or safe parcel query procedure was exposed.
